<!--
Every PR uses these five sections, in this order. CI checks that each one
is present and filled in. Write for a reviewer who has not seen the code:
give context, not just a diff summary. Delete the guidance comments as you go.
-->

## What Problem This Solves

<!--
Describe the problem as the person hitting it experiences it. What was
broken, missing, slow, or confusing? Link the issue if there is one.
-->

## Why This Change Was Made

<!--
Explain the reasoning behind this approach. What alternatives did you
consider and why did you not take them? What constraints shaped the design?
-->

## User Impact

<!--
What changes for someone using Selara: new behavior, changed defaults,
migrations, anything they must do. Say "None" only if nothing user-facing
changed, and explain why.
-->

## Developer Impact

<!--
What changes for people working on the code: new modules or commands,
changed interfaces, config or build steps, follow-up work, known gaps.
-->

## Evidence

<!--
Show that it works. Include the commands you ran and their results, test
output, and screenshots for any UI change (Settings, picker, tray). Note
what CI covers versus what needed local macOS testing. Confirm no secrets,
API keys, tokens, or personal config are in the diff.
-->
